id.description: Unique AIC-JWT DA mode-lattice vector identifier (e.g. aij-ml-001)

kind.description: All vectors assert the binding-profile delegation-mode pre-check.

spec_clause.description: The delegation-mode lattice is a binding-profile pre-check, never a Contains argument.

profile.description: The carrier whose lattice order is pinned here.  The AIC-JWT order is authorized < representative.

parent_mode.description: Delegation mode of the parent boundary grant, or null when the carrier is used without a mode.

child_mode.description: Delegation mode of the child (requested) grant, or null when not bound.

pre_check.description: Expected outcome of the mode pre-check: 'narrows' when the child mode does not widen the parent's; 'delegation_mode_not_narrower' when it does.
